title.zh: 穿越时空与文化的音乐

clips.send: Film and game music. 1930s–today. Film scores use leitmotifs: a short theme for each character (an idea from Wagner’s operas). John Williams’ Star Wars (1977) brought back the full symphony orchestra to the movies. Today game music adapts live to what the player does.

clips.send: Peking opera and pipa classics. 1790, 1818. 1790: four opera troupes from Anhui came to Beijing for the emperor’s birthday — the start of Peking opera 京剧. Peking opera combines singing, speech, acting and acrobatics, led by the percussion band. The pipa epic 《十面埋伏》 “Ambush from Ten Sides,” about the battle of Gaixia (202 BCE), was first printed in a pipa book in 1818.

clips.send: Classical. 1750–1820. Haydn (“father of the symphony”), Mozart and young Beethoven. Clear, balanced melodies over simple accompaniments — elegant, like neat architecture. New forms: the symphony, the string quartet and sonata form.

clips.send: Ragtime, blues and jazz. 1890s–1940s. Created by African American musicians, drawing on spirituals, work songs and West African rhythm. Scott Joplin’s “Maple Leaf Rag” (1899); the 12-bar blues with “blue notes.” The first jazz record came out in 1917; Louis Armstrong made improvised solos the star. Swing big bands (Duke Ellington) followed.

clips.send: Romantic. 1820–1900. Big feelings, bigger orchestras. Beethoven’s late works open the door. Chopin’s piano poetry, Tchaikovsky’s ballets (The Nutcracker, 1892). Composers celebrated their nations’ folk music (Dvořák, Grieg).

clips.send: 20th-century classical. 1900–today. Debussy’s dreamy whole-tone colours; Stravinsky’s The Rite of Spring (1913) caused an uproar at its premiere in Paris. Composers broke old rules: new scales, wild rhythms, electronic sounds. Minimalists (Steve Reich, Philip Glass) built music from short repeating patterns.

clips.send: Hip-hop. 1973–today. 11 August 1973, the Bronx, New York: DJ Kool Herc loops the drum “breaks” of records at a party. Four elements: DJing, MCing (rapping), breakdancing and graffiti. Drum machines like the Roland TR-808 and sampling made new beats — the same step-sequencer idea as our Rhythm lesson.

clips.send: Bronze bells and the guqin. c. 433 BCE. The 65 bells of Marquis Yi of Zeng show China had a full 12-note system 2,400 years ago. The legend of 伯牙 Boya and 钟子期 Zhong Ziqi: Boya played 《高山流水》 “High Mountains, Flowing Water,” and only his friend understood it. A true friend is still called 知音 — “one who knows the sound.” The guqin piece 《流水》 flew into space on Voyager in 1977.

clips.send: Tang dynasty music. 618–907. Chang’an was a world city: music arrived along the Silk Road from Central Asia, including the pipa. Emperor Xuanzong ran a music academy, the 梨园 “Pear Garden” — Chinese opera performers are still nicknamed “children of the Pear Garden.” Grand suites called 大曲 mixed music, song and dance.

clips.send: East meets West. 1959–today. 《梁祝》 The Butterfly Lovers violin concerto (1959, by 何占豪 He Zhanhao and 陈钢 Chen Gang) puts Yue-opera melodies into a Western concerto. Large Chinese orchestras (民族管弦乐团) mix erhu, pipa, dizi and percussion. Tan Dun won the Oscar for best original score for Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon (2000).

clips.send: Baroque. 1600–1750. Opera is born in Italy around 1600. Bach, Vivaldi and Handel. Busy, interlocking melodies (counterpoint) — like a fugue, where one tune chases itself. A harpsichord or organ plays the “basso continuo,” a non-stop bass line.

clips.send: New Chinese music. 1920s–1940s. 刘天华 Liu Tianhua (1895–1932) turned the erhu into a concert solo instrument. Blind street musician 阿炳 Abing (1893–1950): 《二泉映月》, recorded in 1950. 聂耳 Nie Er’s 《义勇军进行曲》 March of the Volunteers (1935) became the national anthem of the PRC; 冼星海 Xian Xinghai’s 《黄河大合唱》 Yellow River Cantata (1939) rallied people during the War of Resistance.

clips.send: 电影与游戏配乐。20 世纪 30 年代至今。电影配乐使用“主导动机”：每个角色都有一个短小的主题（来自瓦格纳的歌剧）。 约翰·威廉姆斯的《星球大战》（1977）让完整的交响乐队重回电影。 今天的游戏音乐会根据玩家的操作实时变化。

clips.send: 浪漫主义时期。1820—1900 年。情感更强烈，乐队更庞大。贝多芬晚期作品打开了大门。 肖邦诗一般的钢琴曲，柴可夫斯基的芭蕾舞剧（《胡桃夹子》，1892）。 作曲家用本民族的民间音乐创作（德沃夏克、格里格）。

clips.send: 中西合璧。1959 年至今。小提琴协奏曲《梁祝》（1959，何占豪、陈钢作曲）把越剧旋律写进了西洋协奏曲。 大型民族管弦乐团融合了二胡、琵琶、笛子和打击乐。 谭盾凭电影《卧虎藏龙》（2000）获得奥斯卡最佳原创配乐奖。

clips.send: 中国新音乐。20 世纪 20—40 年代。刘天华（1895—1932）把二胡变成了音乐会独奏乐器。 盲人民间艺人阿炳（1893—1950）的《二泉映月》，1950 年录音。 聂耳的《义勇军进行曲》（1935）后来成为中华人民共和国国歌；冼星海的《黄河大合唱》（1939）在抗日战争中鼓舞了人民。

clips.send: 拉格泰姆、布鲁斯与爵士乐。19 世纪 90 年代—20 世纪 40 年代。由美国非裔音乐家创造，源于灵歌、劳动号子和西非节奏。 斯科特·乔普林的《枫叶拉格》（1899）；12 小节布鲁斯和“蓝调音”。 1917 年发行了第一张爵士唱片；路易斯·阿姆斯特朗让即兴独奏成为主角。随后是摇摆乐大乐队（艾灵顿公爵）。

clips.text: 唐代音乐. 618—907 年. 长安是国际大都市：音乐随丝绸之路从中亚传来，琵琶就是其中之一。 唐玄宗设立“梨园”培养乐工——今天戏曲演员仍被称为“梨园弟子”。 “大曲”把器乐、歌唱和舞蹈融为一体。

clips.send: 古典主义时期。1750—1820 年。海顿（“交响乐之父”）、莫扎特和青年贝多芬。 旋律清晰、对称，伴奏简洁——像整齐的建筑一样优雅。 新体裁：交响曲、弦乐四重奏和奏鸣曲式。

clips.send: 易错点：《义勇军进行曲》原本是 1935 年一部电影的主题歌，后来才成为国歌。
